results.title: Implementation of Additional Export Controls: Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing Items and Rare Earth Compounds
results.abstract: The Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS), Department of Commerce, amends the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) by adding new Export Control Classification Numbers (ECCNs) and expanding licence requirements for critical mineral processing equipment.
results.excerpts: Export Administration Regulations; license requirements for critical materials.
